About the salon

A Salon Where You Can Feel Your Best.

At Harpers Hair & Beauty, the team pride themselves on delivering award-winning excellence, with affordable professional services in a fun and friendly atmosphere. It’s a place to relax, feel pampered, and leave looking and feeling fantastic.

Our dedicated stylists, including salon owner Kelly, who is Vidal Sassoon trained, bring passion and experience to every appointment, with a commitment to a consistent, high standard of service and care.

From cutting and styling to colouring, we offer a range of techniques to help you achieve the look you want, including contemporary, catwalk-inspired styles.

The team

Recognised for Our Craft

Award-winning excellence is something our team takes pride in, and it shows in how we work: listening first, then cutting, styling and colouring with care. Salon owner Kelly is Vidal Sassoon trained, and the whole team shares the same commitment to a consistent, high standard.

Don’t Just Take Our Word for It.

Words from clients who have visited the salon.

“Had a colour, hair cut and blow dry by Kelly. I am really pleased with the results. Kelly and a colleague took time to discuss the colour I wanted as I didn’t want to go to dark and it came out perfect. Will defo recommend and use all the time now. Many thanks.”

Lydia Wenbourne

“I went into Kelly with a wreck of a hair cut and colour. Kelly looked listened and performed absolute magic. My hair is now my pride and joy again. My hair has not been as good as it is now for some years. I could not recommend her and the salon enough. The ladies in the salon are friendly and make you feel welcomed.”

Tracy

“Very helpful, friendly, lovely staff, good cut and nice range of products. Recommend”

Dee

“Took my 3 year old for her haircut. The staff was fantastic and friendly. She started of nervous but was smiling and loving it by the end. On the way home she asked that we go there again. Thank you for making it such a wonderful experience for Ivy x”

Alexa Jones

“Lucy was recommended by a friend, and I managed to get a last minute booking with her yesterday afternoon! All I can say is.. my friend was absolutely right! We had a quick chat about what I wanted and she skillfully cut my hair perfectly, and really quickly. Whilst cutting my hair, we had a friendly natter, and I left feeling very happy about my cut! Thank you for doing a fab job and squeezing me in at such short notice xxx”
